verification.local_npz_inspection: 13 PAiD robot kick references, 5 LAFAN1 selected walk/run clips, 4 derived straight references inspected with allow_pickle=False.
verification.cmu_acceptance: Known-capture end-to-end check passed for 801 frames, 41 human markers, 3 ball tracks, exact metric conversion, excluded model outputs, missing-data NaN masks and absent source event/force labels.
verification.unsupported_layouts: Truncated data, non-Intel processor encoding and integer-point layouts were each rejected.
verification.provenance: Seven original/provenance files and the selected marker export independently matched recorded SHA-256 and sizes; research files match data/ ignore rule.
verification.independent_c3d_decoding: All five point arrays, source frame numbers and validity masks agree exactly with py-c3d 0.6.0. Four zero-analog-channel files need an explicitly recorded unused analog-header normalization inside the independent reader; originals untouched.
verification.human_coordination_tests: Ten targeted unittest cases passed, including synthetic geometry/invariance/gap handling and all five real clips. Sourcequalification remains false.
